text:
alex: heads-up — we're seeing a class of v1 SDK calls that omit X-API-Version get routed to v2 and some customers report subtle response format breakage. can we discuss a graceful routing fallback? :eyes:

maya: ugh, that makes sense. which requests are missing the header? old SDKs or baked clients?

alex: mostly old SDKs (<=1.3.4) and a few server-side proxies that strip unknown headers. correlation with client_user_agent shows the SDK string.

sam: we should avoid a global revert. proposal: routing precedence: explicit header > sdk-version-mapping table > default (current v2). put mapping table in routing service so we can add entries per customer for a short grace period.

rebecca: agree. also need clear console signals so PM/customer success can see who's in compat mode. UI idea: per-account toggle + migration timeline + deprecation banner.

alex: sketch of routing logic i'm thinking of:

```
if (request.headers['X-API-Version']) {
  route = routeForHeader(request.headers['X-API-Version'])
} else if (mapping = lookupSdkVersionMap(request.metadata.client_sdk)) {
  route = mapping.route
} else {
  route = defaultRoute // v2
}
```

maya: cute. what about quota attribution? if we route to v1 route for grace, do we bill against v1 quotas or v2? billing affects customers and quota dashboards.

sam: for the grace period, bill to the route we actually serve from (so v1 if mapped). but mark telemetry with fields: legacy_grace=true, sdk_version, mapping_source. that'll let finance and CS reconcile.

rebecca: and surface that in the console as a column in per-account usage: "compat routed tokens" with ability to filter by legacy_grace tag. also add a deprecation CTA in the console rollout page.

alex: telemetry events i want emitted:
- routing.decision: { route: v1|v2|mapping, reason: header|sdk_map|default }
- routing.legacy_grace: { account_id, sdk_version, tokens }

sam: add a sampling flag for verbose payloads to avoid noise: sample 5% of these events with full input/response for QA, but keep counters for all.

maya: ops question — how do we seed the mapping table? manually via console or auto-probe?

alex: two sources: 1) manual entries by SE/CS in console; 2) an opt-in migration probe: when we detect sdk_version X across >N requests in 24h, create a tentative mapping in "probe" state that routes 1% of traffic to v1 and collects diffs. only after positive diffs we escalate to 100% for that account.

rebecca: UI should show mapping state: probe(1%) -> canary(10%) -> full(100%) and allow rollback. also tie an alert if quality delta > threshold.

sam: rollout plan suggestion:
- week 0: infra deploy with mapping table + telemetry (no mappings active)
- week 1: enable manual mappings + probe automation (1% probe for auto candidates)
- week 2: CS/SE creates mappings for priority customers (10% canary)
- week 3: move to larger canaries then 100% and remove mapping after 30 days.

alex: permissions: only ops+cs+se should be able to write mappings; console should record audit entries.

maya: alerting: create alerts for error-rate-delta and schema-diff-rate when routing reason != header. add a dashboard tile for compat-mode traffic trend.

rebecca: deprecation messaging — we should add an account-level banner that shows "You're on Legacy API behavior. Migrate by DATE or compat mapping will expire." include migration docs link and quick code snippets.

sam: small nit: we should prefer detecting header variants too (x-api-version vs X-Api-Version). normalize headers in edge.

alex: good call. will add header normalization and fallback priority doc.

deploy-bot: canary routing feature branch deployed to staging -> sha abc123 :rocket:

maya: i'll draft the console wireframes and incidents dashboard panels, pinging @rebecca for copy.

rebecca: happy to help with copy and the deprecation timeline. also recommend a 60-day calendar for public deprecation notice.

alex: ok i'll open the RFC and include pseudocode, telemetry schema, and rollout checklist. volunteers for code review?

sam: me. :thumbsup:

maya: me for UI review.

alex: thanks — will post RFC link once created. :raised_hands:
